artists.biography:
Baxter Dury (born 18 December 1971, Wingrave, Buckinghamshire, England) is an English indie musician, currently signed to Rough Trade Records. He is the son of Ian Dury, and as a five-year-old he appeared on the front cover of Ian's LP New Boots and Panties!!. He left school at the age of fourteen. He has had a 'Record of the Week' in NME with Oscar Brown EP in 2002. He has one son, Kosmo Korda Dury (born 2002) whose mother is the granddaughter of Zoltan Korda.
More recently, Dury has signed a new recording contract with Parlophone.

perplexity.description:
I Thought I Was Better Than You," released on June 2, 2023, is the seventh studio album by English musician Baxter Dury, issued through Heavenly Recordings and [PIAS]. The album blends elements of rock and pop, continuing Dury's signature style characterized by laid-back, sardonic vocals over shuffling basslines and subtle electronic textures. Produced by Paul White alongside Dury, the record features a concise runtime of about 27 minutes, with tracks that mix late-night London atmospheres and introspective storytelling, including semi-autobiographical elements as heard in songs like "Leon" featuring vocalist JGrrey.

This album marks a significant point in Dury's discography, arriving after his 2021 memoir Chaise Longue and showcasing a matured yet still distinctly wry perspective on life and relationships. It achieved Dury's highest UK Albums Chart position to date, peaking at number 41, and also performed well on independent and regional charts, reflecting both critical and commercial recognition. The singles "Aylesbury Boy," "Leon," and "Celebrate Me" helped promote the album, highlighting its blend of pop-rock sensibilities with Dury's characteristic narrative style.
